title: World2Web
description: Publishes in-character session blogs from Foundry journals to a static site. Any journal entry can be marked published as a blog (author/root-path/tags configurable per entry, gear-icon dialog); individual pages are posts, published explicitly via a per-page publish button. 'Publish to Web' pushes directly to GitHub; an optional 'Enable Dev Mode' setting adds a 'Dev Sync' button that downloads the collected payload as JSON for local inspection instead.
